title: Using TypedResults in Controller-Based APIs
description: Learn how to use TypedResults in MVC controllers to return strongly-typed HTTP responses with better performance and compile-time safety.

data.text: TypedResults were introduced in Minimal APIs to provide compile-time checked return types. In .NET 10, you can now use TypedResults in controller-based APIs as well. This gives you the same strong typing and discoverability benefits in traditional MVC or Web API controllers.

Instead of returning IActionResult, you can declare the return type as a specific TypedResults type. The framework handles the conversion to the appropriate HTTP response. This provides compile-time safety and enables better tooling support.

data.title: Using TypedResults in a controller action
data.content: Return strongly-typed results from a controller action in .NET 10

data.text: TypedResults provide compile-time safety by encoding the HTTP status code and content type into the return type. This eliminates the possibility of returning mismatched content and makes the API contract explicit without relying on XML documentation or conventions.

rows: Weak — any IActionResult can be returned
Strong — type encodes status code and content type
Same TypedResults types work in controllers and minimal APIs
Renaming TypedResults.Ok<T> keeps the contract clear

data.title: Migration Strategy
data.text: You can migrate to TypedResults gradually. Start with the simplest GET actions, then expand to POST, PUT, and DELETE as you become comfortable. Mixed returns of TypedResults and IActionResult are supported.

TypedResults includes strongly-typed versions of all common HTTP results. Each variant carries the correct content type and status code information, so OpenAPI generators can infer accurate schema information without attributes.

data.title: Summary
points: TypedResults are now available in controller-based APIs in .NET 10.
They provide compile-time safety and self-documenting return types.
You can mix TypedResults and IActionResult in the same controller during migration.
OpenAPI generators produce more accurate schemas from TypedResults.
data.takeaway: TypedResults bridge the gap between Minimal APIs and controllers, giving you strong typing and better tooling without abandoning your existing controller architecture.
